# Administrative Section Module - FIXED
---

```{r}
#| label: admin-setup
#| include: false

# The data should already be loaded from the parent document
# We just need to process it here
```

```{r}
#| label: admin-html-display
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

# CRITICAL FIX: Group by institution AND title to consolidate ALL bullets
admin_grouped <- admin %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(institution, title) %>%
  summarise(
    all_details = list(detail),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Display metrics if needed
if (exists("show_metrics") && show_metrics) {
  # ... metrics code ...
}

# Display grouped administrative roles
for (i in 1:nrow(admin_grouped)) {
  cat(paste0('
<div class="admin-role">
<div class="role-header">
<strong class="role-title">', admin_grouped$title[i], '</strong>
<span class="institution">', admin_grouped$institution[i], '</span>
</div>
<ul class="role-details">
'))
  
  # Add ALL details as bullets
  for (detail in admin_grouped$all_details[[i]]) {
    cat(paste0('<li>', detail, '</li>\n'))
  }
  
  cat('</ul>\n</div>\n\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| label: admin-pdf-display
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

# Group by institution AND title for PDF
admin_grouped <- admin %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(institution, title) %>%
  summarise(
    all_details = list(detail),
    display_order = first(display_order),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

for (i in 1:nrow(admin_grouped)) {
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(admin_grouped$title[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(admin_grouped$institution[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
  
  # Add ALL details as bullets
  for (detail in admin_grouped$all_details[[i]]) {
    cat("\\item ", escape_latex(detail), "\n", sep = "")
  }
  
  cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
}
```
